text: No, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020). The 67.7 ha loss occurred in 2020, which is *before* the baseline date. After 2020, only 0.4 ha of tree cover was lost in 2021, but this was in patches smaller than 0.5 ha and thus not counted as an event. The JRC 2020 reference also confirms no forest cover remained by 2020. All losses after the baseline were minor and below the minimum event threshold.
